properties.areaDesc: Coastal Volusia; Mainland Northern Brevard; Northern Brevard Barrier Islands; Mainland Southern Brevard; Southern Brevard Barrier Islands
properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 7 at 2:52AM EDT until October 8 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description: * WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.  * WHERE...Coastal Volusia and Brevard Counties.  * WHEN...Through late tonight.  * IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper water.
properties.instruction:
Rip currents are powerful channels of water flowing quickly away
from shore, which occur most often at low spots or breaks in the
sandbar and in the vicinity of structures such as jetties and
piers. Heed the advice of lifeguards, beach patrol flags and
signs.

Entering the surf is strongly discouraged. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 6 at 10:50PM PDT until October 8 at 1:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description: * WHAT...Up to 0.8 ft of inundation above ground level is possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.  * WHERE...Bayshore locations along the San Pablo Bay.  * WHEN...Until 1 PM PDT Thursday.  * IMPACTS...High tides will result in flooding of low-lying infrastructure, isolated road closures, and coastal erosion. Rising tides will bring water and waves farther up the beach than normal, restricting escape from beaches and coastal areas.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...At the San Francisco tidal gauge, high tide is expected to be 0.6 ft above normal (6.44 ft MLLW) at 10:19 AM Wednesday 10/7 and 0.8 ft above normal (6.68 ft MLLW) at 10:51 AM Thursday 10/8. These predictions include up to 0.9 ft of surge that will enhance the astronomical tide and flooding threat. High tide varies up to 90 minutes earlier or later along the Pacific Coast and through the San Francisco Bay, respectively.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
